dct_description_sm: Type: Release data for Cumulative profile components: Notes: 1. July 17, 2007: Age and sex; 2. September 12, 2007: Marital status, Common-law status, Families, Dwellings and households; 3. December 4, 2007: Language, Immigration, Citizenship, Mobility and migration; 5. January 15, 2008: Aboriginal peoples; March 4. 2008: labour market activity, Industry, Occupation, Education, Language of work, Place of work and mode of transportation; 6. April 2, 2008: Ethnic origin and visible minorities; 7. May 1, 2008: Complete cumulative profile, including Income and earnings, and Shelter costs.

The Census 2006 Profile Series presents statistical overviews of regions, representing most census variable for the following levels of geography: Canada, Province and Territory, Federal Electoral District (FED) (2003 Representation Order), Census Metropolitan Area/Census Agglomeration (CMA/CA), Census Division/Census Subdivision (CD/CSD) and Census Tract (CT). Variables includes: Age and sex, Marital status, Common-law status, Families, Dwellings and households, Language, Mobility and migration, Immigration, Citizenship, Ethnic origin and visible minorities, Aboriginal peoples, Labour market activity, Occupation, Industry, Place of work and mode of transportation, Language of work, Education, Income and earnings and Shelter costs. Cumulative Profiles contain all census variables by single geographic level.  Aggregate data tables are presented in Beyond 2020 format (.ivt).
